# Request for Comments (RFC) Index

Design proposals under discussion, and the record of ones already settled.

To propose a change, add a new RFC using the `rfc-skill` skill. Approved RFCs
produce one or more ADRs in `../adr/`; the RFC stays here as the record of how
the decision was reached.

**Status meanings:** `draft` (still being written) · `in-review` (open for
feedback) · `approved` (consensus reached) · `rejected` (declined by
reviewers) · `withdrawn` (pulled by the author).
